bachelor.en: You need a recognised school-leaving certificate or an equivalent pre-university qualification, transcripts and subjects that fit the programme. Official general guidelines usually mention 12 years of schooling, so direct entry with Uzbekistan’s 11-year certificate is not automatic: equivalence, a foundation year or another extra step must be checked with the university. For English-taught programmes, preparing for around IELTS Academic 5.5–6.5 is a useful target, but medicine, law, languages and other programmes differ.
bachelor.uz: Tan olinadigan maktab attestati yoki unga teng pre-university malaka, baholar ilovasi va yo‘nalishga mos fanlar kerak. Rasmiy umumiy yo‘riqnomalarda odatda 12 yillik ta’lim ko‘rsatiladi, shuning uchun O‘zbekistonning 11 yillik attestati bilan to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri kirish avtomatik emas: ekvivalentlik, foundation yoki boshqa qo‘shimcha ta’lim yo‘li universitetda tekshirilishi kerak. Inglizcha dasturlar uchun IELTS Academic 5.5–6.5 atrofi foydali tayyorgarlik mo‘ljali, lekin tibbiyot, huquq, til va boshqa dasturlarda talab farq qiladi.

master.en: A recognised bachelor’s degree, transcripts and suitable academic background. GPA thresholds depend on the university and study mode; 2.75–3.00/4.00 and IELTS 6.0–6.5 are common, but some programmes admit lower GPAs with work experience or extra assessment. Coursework, mixed-mode and research master’s differ: research programmes check your research plan and fit with a supervisor.
master.uz: Tan olinadigan bakalavr diplomi, transkript va dasturga mos akademik tayyorgarlik. GPA chegarasi universitet va o‘qish turiga bog‘liq; 2.75–3.00/4.00 va IELTS 6.0–6.5 ko‘p uchraydi, lekin ayrim dasturlar pastroq GPA’ni ish tajribasi yoki qo‘shimcha baholash bilan qabul qiladi. Coursework, mixed mode va research magistraturasi farq qiladi: research dasturlarida tadqiqot rejasi va ilmiy rahbar bilan moslik tekshiriladi.

notes.en: INTI International University (Nilai) is not the same as the other INTI colleges.
notes.uz: INTI International University (Nilai) boshqa INTI kollejlari bilan bir xil emas.

bachelor.en: A recognised secondary school diploma, transcript, English translations, passport and proof of the language of instruction. English-taught programmes usually expect B2; around IELTS 5.5–6.5 is a general target. Depending on the programme: motivation letter, online interview, or an entrance exam in maths or other subjects. Medicine may test biology, chemistry and English separately.
bachelor.uz: Tan olinadigan o‘rta ta’lim diplomi, baholar ilovasi, inglizcha tarjimalar, pasport va ta’lim tilini bilish isboti. Inglizcha dasturlar odatda B2 kutadi; IELTS 5.5–6.5 atrofi umumiy mo‘ljal. Dasturga qarab: motivatsion xat, onlayn suhbat, matematika yoki boshqa fandan kirish imtihoni. Tibbiyotda biologiya, kimyo va ingliz tilidan alohida sinov bo‘lishi mumkin.

master.en: Bachelor’s diploma, transcript, and matching courses and credits matter. Some programmes ask graduates of other fields for extra credits. Prepare B2–C1 language, motivation, CV and interview; certificate and reference requirements depend on the programme. IELTS 6.0–6.5 is a useful planning target, but some programmes ask 7.0 or test language in the admission exam. There is no single national GPA minimum.
master.uz: Bakalavr diplomi, transkript, o‘tilgan fanlar va kreditlarning mosligi muhim. Ayrim dasturlar boshqa yo‘nalish bitiruvchilaridan qo‘shimcha kredit talab qiladi. B2–C1 til, motivatsiya, CV va suhbatga tayyorlaning; sertifikat va tavsiyanoma talabi dasturga bog‘liq. IELTS 6.0–6.5 rejalashtirish uchun foydali mo‘ljal, lekin ayrim dasturlar 7.0 so‘raydi yoki tilni qabul imtihonida baholaydi. Butun mamlakat uchun yagona GPA minimumi yo‘q.

notes.en: Semmelweis General Medicine is a one-tier (integrated) programme straight after school — not a 3-year bachelor’s or a 2-year master’s.
notes.uz: Semmelweis General Medicine — maktabdan keyingi uzluksiz (bir bosqichli) dastur; u oddiy 3 yillik bakalavr ham, 2 yillik magistratura ham emas.

notes.en: Central European University (CEU) is not included only because of its historical link with Budapest: its degree programmes moved to Vienna, Austria (2019–2020). Check the current campus and country of any programme yourself.
notes.uz: Central European University (CEU) faqat Budapest bilan tarixiy bog‘liqligi sabab ro‘yxatga qo‘shilmagan: uning daraja dasturlari Avstriyaning Vena shahriga ko‘chgan (2019–2020). Har qanday dasturning amaldagi kampusi va davlatini o‘zingiz tekshiring.

bachelor.en: The first question is whether your certificate gives a university entrance qualification (HZB). Depending on the certificate, years of schooling and earlier university study, you may enter directly or need the Studienkolleg and Feststellungsprüfung. Check your own case on uni-assist/anabin. Many bachelor’s programmes are taught in German (B2–C1, e.g. TestDaF TDN 4 or DSH-2 in some programmes — not the same everywhere). Some programmes have quotas, grade-based selection, portfolios or aptitude tests.
bachelor.uz: Birinchi savol — attestatingiz universitetga kirish huquqini (HZB) beradimi. Attestat turi, o‘qish yillari va oldingi universitet ta’limiga qarab to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri kirish yoki Studienkolleg va Feststellungsprüfung kerak bo‘lishi mumkin. O‘z holatingizni uni-assist/anabin orqali tekshiring. Ko‘p bakalavr dasturlari nemis tilida (B2–C1; ayrim dasturlarda TestDaF TDN 4 yoki DSH-2 — hamma joyda bir xil emas). Ayrim yo‘nalishlarda kvota, baholar bo‘yicha tanlov, portfolio yoki qobiliyat sinovi bor.

master.en: A related bachelor’s degree, transcript, course descriptions and matching credits are crucial — a high GPA alone may not be enough (e.g. set credits in economics, maths, statistics or programming). Many programmes check for a 180 or 210 ECTS degree. For English-taught master’s, around IELTS 6.5–7.0 is a preparation target. CV, motivation, references, GRE/GMAT or interview are required only where the programme says so.
master.uz: Tegishli bakalavr diplomi, transkript, fanlar tavsifi va kreditlar mosligi juda muhim — faqat yuqori GPA yetarli bo‘lmasligi mumkin (masalan, iqtisodiyot, matematika, statistika yoki dasturlashdan aniq kreditlar). Ko‘p dasturlar 180 yoki 210 ECTSga mos darajani tekshiradi. Inglizcha magistratura uchun IELTS 6.5–7.0 atrofi tayyorgarlik mo‘ljali. CV, motivatsiya, tavsiyanoma, GRE/GMAT yoki suhbat faqat dastur talab qilsa majburiy.

notes.en: In German grading a smaller number can mean a better result — do not convert a foreign GPA with a simple percentage.
notes.uz: Nemis baholash tizimida kichikroq son yaxshiroq natijani bildirishi mumkin — xorijiy GPA’ni oddiy foiz bilan almashtirmang.

notes.en: uni-assist is not one portal for all universities: some use it for document checks or a VPD, and the application itself goes to the university portal.
notes.uz: uni-assist barcha universitetlar uchun yagona portal emas: ayrimlari undan hujjat tekshiruvi yoki VPD uchun foydalanadi, ariza esa universitet portaliga topshiriladi.

notes.en: Not every German university is free: TUM charges many non-EU/EEA students tuition, and Baden-Württemberg (Heidelberg, KIT, Tübingen, Freiburg) charges non-EU students.
notes.uz: Germaniyadagi hamma universitet bepul emas: TUM ko‘plab non-EU/EEA talabalardan kontrakt oladi, Baden-Vyurtemberg (Heidelberg, KIT, Tübingen, Freiburg) ham non-EU talabalardan to‘lov oladi.

notes.en: uni-assist: translations of Uzbek documents must be attested by an Uzbek notary (see the uni-assist country page).
notes.uz: uni-assist: o‘zbekcha hujjatlar tarjimasi O‘zbekiston notariusi tomonidan tasdiqlanishi kerak (uni-assist davlat sahifasiga qarang).

bachelor.en: School certificate, all school grades, passport and a diploma or exam result the university accepts. Which of TR-YÖS, SAT, A-Level, IB or a national diploma is accepted depends on the university — not every university asks for SAT, and TR-YÖS does not open every door. English-taught programmes use the university’s own proficiency exam or accepted international tests; Turkish-taught programmes need an accepted Turkish certificate. A preparatory year exists where needed. Check whether the equivalence (denklik) document is needed at application or at registration.
bachelor.uz: Attestat, barcha maktab baholari, pasport va universitet qabul qiladigan diplom yoki imtihon natijasi kerak. TR-YÖS, SAT, A-Level, IB yoki milliy diplomdan qaysi biri qabul qilinishi universitetga bog‘liq — hamma universitet SAT so‘ramaydi, TR-YÖS bilan istalgan joyga kirib bo‘lmaydi. Inglizcha dasturlarda universitetning o‘z imtihoni yoki qabul qilinadigan xalqaro test; turkcha dasturlarda qabul qilinadigan turk tili sertifikati kerak. Kerak bo‘lsa tayyorlov yili bor. Denklik hujjati ariza paytida yoki ro‘yxatdan o‘tishda kerakligini tekshiring.

master.en: A recognised bachelor’s diploma, transcript, matching field, CV, motivation and references if the programme asks. Thesis and non-thesis master’s differ. ALES, GRE or GMAT, exemptions for international applicants and interviews are set per university/faculty. Check which TOEFL, PTE or university exam an English-taught programme accepts — do not assume IELTS is accepted. There is no single national GPA minimum; aiming for 3.0/4.0 or higher can strengthen an application but is not an official rule.
master.uz: Tan olinadigan bakalavr diplomi, transkript, mos mutaxassislik, CV, motivatsiya va dastur so‘rasa tavsiyanoma. Tezisli va tezissiz magistratura farq qiladi. ALES, GRE yoki GMAT talabi, xorijliklar uchun istisnolar va suhbat universitet/fakultet bo‘yicha belgilanadi. Inglizcha dastur qaysi TOEFL, PTE yoki universitet imtihonini qabul qilishini tekshiring — IELTS’ni avtomatik mos deb hisoblamang. Yagona milliy GPA minimumi yo‘q; 3.0/4.0 va undan yuqoriga intilish arizani kuchaytirishi mumkin, lekin rasmiy shart emas.

notes.en: Istanbul University and Istanbul University-Cerrahpaşa are separate universities.
notes.uz: Istanbul University va Istanbul University-Cerrahpaşa — alohida universitetlar.

notes.en: METU and Sabancı (and METU master’s) do not accept IELTS for the purposes stated on their pages.
notes.uz: METU va Sabancı (hamda METU magistraturasi) o‘z sahifalarida ko‘rsatilgan maqsadlar uchun IELTS’ni qabul qilmaydi.

bachelor.en: Completed recognised schooling, certificate, transcript, proof of the language of instruction, and a personal statement or study plan. Many international tracks ask for documents on the citizenship of the applicant and parents and the family relationship; the exact rule depends on the track. Take apostille/consular rules from the guide. For Korean-taught programmes TOPIK 3–4 can be a starting point for some tracks, but it may be higher. For English-taught programmes, around IELTS 6.0–6.5 is a general target. A recommended score is not a minimum; SAT/AP/IB are not required everywhere.
bachelor.uz: Tan olinadigan tugallangan maktab ta’limi, attestat, transkript, ta’lim tili bo‘yicha hujjat, shaxsiy bayonot yoki study plan kerak. Ko‘p xalqaro yo‘llarda abituriyent va ota-onasining fuqaroligi hamda qarindoshlikni tasdiqlovchi hujjatlar so‘raladi; aniq mezon yo‘lga bog‘liq. Apostil yoki konsullik tasdig‘i qoidasini qo‘llanmadan oling. Koreyscha dasturlarda TOPIK 3–4 ayrim yo‘llar uchun boshlang‘ich mezon bo‘lishi mumkin, lekin yuqoriroq ham bo‘lishi mumkin. Inglizcha dasturlar uchun IELTS 6.0–6.5 atrofi umumiy mo‘ljal. Tavsiya qilingan ball — minimal ball emas; SAT/AP/IB hamma joyda majburiy emas.

master.en: Bachelor’s diploma, transcript, CV, study plan or research proposal, references the programme requires, and language proof. In research-based STEM programmes fit with a lab and supervisor matters, but prior supervisor approval is not required everywhere. Language requirements differ for Korean- and English-taught programmes; IELTS 6.0–6.5 or higher is useful preparation, but take the exact condition from the source.
master.uz: Bakalavr diplomi, transkript, CV, study plan yoki research proposal, dastur talab qilgan tavsiyanomalar va til isboti. Tadqiqotga asoslangan STEM dasturlarida laboratoriya va ilmiy rahbar bilan moslik muhim, lekin oldindan rahbar roziligi hamma joyda majburiy emas. Til talabi koreyscha va inglizcha dasturga qarab farq qiladi; IELTS 6.0–6.5 yoki undan yuqori tayyorgarlik foydali, lekin aniq shartni manbadan oling.

notes.en: Hanyang Seoul and Hanyang ERICA (Ansan) have separate admission routes.
notes.uz: Hanyang Seoul va Hanyang ERICA (Ansan) qabul yo‘llari alohida.

notes.en: The latest admission guide always takes priority over a FAQ page.
notes.uz: Eng so‘nggi qabul qo‘llanmasi har doim FAQ sahifasidan ustun turadi.
